gloss: art world; art circles; painting establishment

definitions.gloss: art world; art circles; painting establishment
definitions.explanation: The collective community of painters and the institutional world of fine art, including exhibitions, critics, art associations, and the social networks surrounding painting. Often used when discussing trends, influence, or standing within the painting community.

examples.japanese: {画壇|がだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Attract attention in the art world.

notes:
A compound of {画|が} (painting, picture) and ⟦{壇|だん}→壇：23016_dan⟧ (platform, stage — here meaning a professional arena or circle). The ⟦{壇|だん}→壇：23016_dan⟧ suffix is used in several words to denote professional or intellectual communities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画壇|がだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appear on the art scene
- {画壇|がだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{牽引|けんいん}→牽引：13498_kenin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lead the art world
- {画壇|がだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重鎮|じゅうちん}: a leading figure in the art world
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{画壇|がだん}: the Japanese art world

RELATED {壇|だん} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{文壇|ぶんだん}→文壇：22666_bundan⟧: literary world, literary circles
- {歌壇|かだん}: poetry world, waka circles
- {論壇|ろんだん}: world of opinion/commentary, pundit circles
- {楽壇|がくだん}: music world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美術界|びじゅつかい}: art world — a broader term covering all visual arts, not just painting
- {芸術界|げいじゅつかい}: art world — even broader, encompassing music, theater, and all performing arts
